title: Tall enough to ride
prompt:
A fun fair ride lets in visitors who are at least 120 cm tall.

Write a function `can_ride(height)` that returns the text `"Ride"` when the height is 120 or more, and `"Too short"` otherwise.

For example, `can_ride(130)` returns `"Ride"`.
hints: You need a condition that compares the height with 120.
Exactly 120 cm is allowed, so think about `>` versus `>=`.
`if height >= 120:` return one text, `else:` return the other.
